learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the basic principles of internal combustion engines and analysis of ideal cycles.
Knowledge and analysis of air - fuel ideal cycles.
Analyze the real cycles. Knowledge of various parameters on engine performance.
Knowledge of the main components of internal combustion engines and their functions.
Knowledge about fundamentals of engine dynamics and application of these fundamentals.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION: Classification of machines, internal combustion engines and principle of internal combustion engines.
IDEAL CYCLES: Analysis of Otto and diesel cycles. EXPERIMENT I.
IDEAL CYCLES: Analysis of dual cycles and comparison of ideal cycles. Deviations of real engine cycles from ideal cycles.
COMBUSTION and ENERGY OF FUEL-AIR MIXTURE: Fuels and chemical properties of fuels. Combustion chemistry and energy of mixture.
IDEAL AIR-FUEL CYCLES: Analysis of air-fuel cycles using thermodynamic charts.
REAL ENGINE CYCLES: Description of real engine cycles. Combustion speed. Analysis of real cycles, specific fuel consumption.
REAL ENGINE CYCLES: Air capacity and volumetric efficiency.
REAL ENGINE CYCLES:. Flame propagation and factors affecting the flame propagation. EXPERIMENT II.
REAL ENGINE CYCLES: Knock in spark ignition and compression ignition engines. Ignition delay and factors affecting the ignition delay.
Air and fuel induction: Description and fundamentals of carburetors. Analysis of fuel and air flow in carburetors. Description of different types of c
Air and fuel induction: Description and classification of injection systems. Advantages and disadvantages of injection systems.
ENGINE MECHANICS: Piston-crank relationship. Forces acting on engine parts and their analysis. Calculation of mass of flywheels.
ENGINE BALANCE: Balance of single cylinder engines.
ENGINE BALANCE: Balance of multi cylinder engines.
bibliography: Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals, J. B. Heywood, McGraw Hill Book Company.
İçten Yanmalı Motorlar, B. Safgönül, M. Ergeneman, H. E. Arslan ve C. Soruşbay, Birsen Yayınevi, 1995.
Engineering Fundamentals of the Internal Combustion Engine, W. W. Pulkrabek, Prentice Hall.
